intro: Lesson 60: Coastal flooding and conflicts at the coast (2.3a). Answer every question. Show your working. Mark it with the mark scheme and log any errors in your repair list.

questions.q: Exam practice: (a) State two causes of coastal flooding. (2) (b) Explain why some coastal areas are vulnerable to flooding. (4) (c) Analyse the conflicts between two users of a coastline. (6)
questions.a: (a) storm surge, sea-level rise (b) low-lying, dense population, poverty, little protection (c) two users' needs, why they clash, effects
questions.model: Teacher plans (c) using the stakeholder diagram.

questions.a: Rising sea pushes habitats inland (1); sea walls block them (1); salt marshes are lost (1)

questions.q: Explain why sea-level rise increases flood risk.
questions.a: Higher average sea levels (1) mean surges and high tides reach further inland and overtop defences more often (1)
questions.model: Cause: warming water expands; ice melts. Effect: higher sea. Risk: surges reach further.
